label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.75 a.2…: The designated human intellectual principle can…
locator: I q.75 a.2 co.: homo per intellectum cognoscere potest naturas omnium corporum
interpretation: The text attributes to human intellect capacity to know the natures of all bodies. The formal reading ranges over bodily natures, not all facts, all beings, or a single jointly exercised act.
